snapshot.name: Clean Science & Technology Ltd
snapshot.about: Incorporated in 2003, Clean Science and Technology Ltd is one of the leading chemical manufacturers globally. It manufactures functionally critical specialty chemicals such as Performance Chemicals (MEHQ, BHA, and AP), Pharmaceutical Intermediates (Guaiacol and DCC), and FMCG Chemicals (4-MAP and Anisole). guidance.statement: Gross margins will improve due to starting key starting materials for HALS products.
guidance.quote: On cost improvement fronts, during the quarter and also in the subsequent quarters, we will be starting some of the key starting materials for some of these HALS products, which eventually will result in improvement in our gross margin.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: The new product commercial launch is expected to commence in H2 of FY27.
guidance.quote: This marks a significant milestone towards the commercial launch of the new product expected to commence in H2 of FY27.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: A 1000 ton line plant should start by April or May.
guidance.quote: And now we believe we have to put up a 1,000 ton line, and we will do so and the plant should start by April or May.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Margins will keep improving quarter-on-quarter as higher grades of HALS pick up.
guidance.quote: So basically, again, like I think every quarter-on-quarter, we should see improvement because the higher grade of HALS will start seeing picking up. So as this movement will start happening quarter-on-quarter basis, but the margins will also keep improving quarter-on-quarter.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Capacity utilization is expected to touch between 55% to 60% in the coming few quarters.
guidance.quote: So currently, I think we are at about 30%, 35% capacity utilization - 40%. And I think going forward, we expect that the coming few quarters, we should touch between 55% to 60% capacity utilization.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: There could be a 5% to 7% improvement in margins for particular segments of HALS.
guidance.quote: So there could be between 5%, 7% improvement in margins for those particular segment of HALS.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Overall HALS capacity will increase to close to 12,500 tons with advanced grade additions.
guidance.quote: With this NOR Collaboration Association, we would like to add incremental capacity only in the advanced grade of HALS. So that will take out our overall capacity to close to 12,500 tons.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Annualized revenue is expected to be INR 250 to 300 crores, translating to 30% to 35% growth.
guidance.quote: So basically, I told you in terms of revenue this year, the target is between INR250 crores to INR300 crores, okay? So that could be around 30% to 35% of overall revenue growth.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Kemin offtake is expected to increase by 20% to 40%.
guidance.quote: Kemin, probably our offtake will increase by 20% to 40%.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: EBITDA margins will continue improving with sales of higher grade products.
guidance.quote: We will see EBITDA margins will keep improving, because as we get into sales of more and more higher grade, the EBITDA margins will keep improving.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Expecting revenue of INR 260 crores for Performance Chemical 1 at around 80% capacity utilization.
guidance.quote: with the Performance Chemical 1 because of the prices reduction overall, the -- around 80% capacity utilization, we are looking at a revenue of INR260 crores
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Performance Chemical 2 facility will begin by May, June.
guidance.quote: the facility will only begin by May, June.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Revenues for Performance Chemical 2 are expected only in Q4.
guidance.quote: we should only see revenues in Q4.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Targeting around 50% utilization over a 2-year period for new products.
guidance.quote: at least around 50% of utilization over a 2-year period. But our endeavor continues to remain to stand by that guidance.
guidance.speaker: Management

guidance.statement: Exports are expected to quickly start ramping up as we move into quarter 4 and FY27.
guidance.quote: we expect the exports to quickly start ramping up.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: EBITDA margins will improve over the next few quarters.
guidance.quote: So I think th is will keep improving over the next few quarters.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Expect decent numbers coming in FY '27 from the new plant.
guidance.quote: we expect decent numbers coming in FY '27.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: We expect sequential growth in quarters 3 and 4, though we will not quantify it.
guidance.quote: we expect a good growth, I mean at least a sequential growth, but we do not want to quantify it at this stage.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Full-scale capacity for the performance chemical plant is expected to generate about INR300 crores in revenue at current prices.
guidance.quote: envisage a revenue of about INR300 odd crores with the current prices which are at currently all-time low prices.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: We endeavour to keep growing the HALS business on a quarter-to-quarter basis.
guidance.quote: our endeavour is to keep growing this on a quarter-to-quarter basis because as we are growing, this was a new business line
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Margins will keep improving quarter-on-quarter with higher grades and better product mix.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating profit margins actually dropped from 36.0% in Jun 2026 to 31.0% in Sep 2026, and fluctuated in prior quarters.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Expect sequential growth in quarters 3 and 4.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Sales dropped from 245.0 in Sep 2025 to 220.0 in Dec 2025, failing the sequential growth promise.

promises.credibility: Management frequently promises sequential margin and revenue improvements, but reported numbers show fluctuating profitability and occasional quarterly dips that contradict their optimistic narrative.

bull: The balance sheet remains exceptionally strong with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.00 and investments of ₹397 Cr exceeding borrowings of ₹2 Cr.
Latest quarter revenue for Sep 2026 grew by 22% YoY alongside a positive EBITDA growth of 6% and a 30.8% margin.
Future growth capacity is expanding with ongoing capital expenditure where CWIP represents 21% of fixed assets.
bear: Growth has slowed significantly, reflected by a 3-year revenue CAGR of just 1% compared to 13% over 5 years.
Profitability is lagging behind revenue as evidenced by a 3-year PAT CAGR of -8% versus revenue growth of 1%.
Operating margins have compressed with Sep 2026 OPM at 30.8% (-4.7pp YoY) compared to the 44% prior years average.
